reviews.shade: Ariul Stress Relieving Daily Pick Toning Pad 30 Sheets
reviews.text: this is not as great as the mediheal ones, it’s not as moisturizing as i thought, i only bought it for travel use. but i dont think i will buy it again!
reviews.zh: 唔及 mediheal 嗰啲咁好，保濕效果冇我想像中咁好，我只係為咗旅行先買。不過我諗我唔會再買！

reviews.shade: Ariul Stress Relieving Daily Pick Toning Pad 30 Sheets
reviews.text: I recently purchased this wipes not knowing how effecient it is remove make up and hydrate you ur skin at the same time. Abosulatey! Going to make a regular purchase.
reviews.zh: 我最近買咗呢款濕紙巾，未知道佢可以同時卸妝同補充皮膚水分，效果真係好好！絕對好！會長期固定購買。

reviews.shade: Ariul Stress Relieving Daily Pick Toning Pad 30 Sheets
reviews.text: I put these in my work bag and give my face a wipe after my shift, i work in a restaurant so my face feels greasy after the days finished but these wipes cleanse my face nicely without drying, keeps me fresh until I'm able to do my full routine once i get home
reviews.zh: 我將呢款放落我嘅工作袋入面，放工後抹一抹面。我喺餐廳做嘢，放工後面成日都覺得油膩，但係呢款濕紙巾可以好好咁清潔面部，又唔會乾，令我保持清爽，直到返到屋企可以做齊成套護膚為止。

reviews.shade: Ariul Stress Relieving Daily Pick Toning Pad 30 Sheets
reviews.text: Been using this, almost on the daily, after my shift from work where I end up sweating 8/10 x. I keep them in my work locker. So far it's been keeping my skin in check before I have a proper cleanse at home. Will buy again once in stock.
reviews.zh: 我差唔多每日都用，放工之後好多時出好多汗（8/10 次）。我將佢放喺工作櫃入面。到目前為止，佢幫我控制住皮膚狀況，等我返屋企正式洗面之前都冇問題。等有貨再買。

reviews.shade: Ariul Stress Relieving Daily Pick Toning Pad 30 Sheets
reviews.text: My holy grail, I love this product. When I first bought them I didn’t expect a difference but I noticed it was helping calm. I hope they restock more of it soon.
reviews.zh: 我嘅必備之選，好鍾意呢款產品。第一次買嗰陣，我冇期望會有咩效果，但係留意到佢有助舒緩皮膚。希望佢哋快啲補多啲貨。

reviews.shade: Ariul Stress Relieving Daily Pick Toning Pad 30 Sheets
reviews.text: I’m not sure how to rate “adhesion” for this product but it rather makes my skin mat. I like it! I use it in my skin cycling routine. I’m not sure how many percent exfoliant ingredients are included but I feel the different after the use. Might have to do with using the pad as physical exfoliant but I like it. I wish the liquid was included more in the pack. It dries out before I use my entire pace.
reviews.zh: 我唔確定點樣評「貼合度」，但係呢款令我皮膚變得啞光。我好鍾意！我用緊佢嚟做皮膚循環護理（skin cycling）。我唔知道內含幾多百分比嘅去角質成分，但用完都感覺到分別。可能係因為用棉片做咗物理去角質，不過我都幾鍾意。我希望包裝入面嘅液體可以多啲，未用完成包就已經乾咗。

reviews.shade: Ariul Stress Relieving Daily Pick Toning Pad 30 Sheets
reviews.text: It’s great to use before applying foundation or sunscreen. I got this for my travel and was surprised by the quality of it. You can think of this as a portable version of the toner pads that come in a round plastic case.
reviews.zh: 喺擦粉底或者防曬之前用都好好。我係為咗旅行買嘅，對佢嘅質素幾驚喜。你可以當佢係一款可以攜帶嘅版本，原本嘅化妝水棉片係裝喺圓形膠盒入面。

reviews.shade: Ariul Stress Relieving Daily Pick Toning Pad 30 Sheets
reviews.text: Продукт понравился! Подушечки освежают и тонизируют! Кожа после применения приятная. Использую вместо тонера в путешествии и дома. Раздражения нет. Довольна покупкой, закажу снова, как закончатся!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款產品！棉片清新又爽膚。用完之後皮膚感覺舒服。喺旅行同屋企都用嚟代替化妝水。冇刺激。好滿意今次購買，用完咗會再訂！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
